scheme_name: Export Promotion Council Membership Reimbursement Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe
other_conditions: Applicant must represent any Micro and Small Enterprise (MSE).
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 80% or ₹20,000 (whichever is lower) of the annual/one‑time Export Promotion Council membership fee for eligible SC/ST micro and small enterprises.
